summary.headline: Sagittarius: Temperament and Regions
summary.text: Astrological description of Sagittarius: its qualities, windy and wet temperament by decan and region, associated lands and seas, and bodily governance of the thighs and groins, with predictions of superfluous limbs, epilepsy, eye pain, mutilation, and danger from beasts.
